sources.title: Equinix invierte US$28 millones para ampliar la capacidad de su centro de datos BG2 en Bogotá (Equinix press release, 20 August 2026)
sources.summary: Dated Bogotá, August 20, 2026. Equinix announces the expansion of its IBX BG2 data centre in Bogotá: an additional US$28 million investment adding 550 new cabinets and doubling the site's capacity. BG2 was originally announced in 2022 with a US$45 million investment; its first phase provided 550 cabinets, and this expansion is the project's second phase. Equinix Americas, LATAM and Chile/Colombia/Peru executives are quoted on the expansion. No construction start, completion date, permit or site address is given.
sources.date_semantics: Press release dated 20 August 2026 (dateline). It announces the second phase; it does not report physical works, completion or operation of the new phase.
